policies: Description = the mined report text exactly as stored in the draft (issue title + body, truncated by the miner at about 800 characters). Leakage was judged by the auditor on this exact text.
A quoted stack trace or error message is realistic symptom evidence, not a mechanism statement: it can make a task easier (higher lexical overlap) but does not make it invalid.
indirect_boundary = the first non-call link on the path from the user-visible entry point to the root cause (job | event | di | db | graphql | other | none); the auditor's corrections are applied.
Auditor verdicts and fixes are applied as recorded unless overridden below; rejected tasks are excluded, never repaired by rewriting the report.

reasons: Auditor flagged a stack trace quoting the failing expression: kept under the stack-trace policy (counted as symptom evidence; lexical overlap computed mechanically).
